# HoverCard access (P68)

Compared against Ikuisuus's keyword cards (`src/modules/library/presentation/components/Keyword`, `DetachableTooltip`, `CardChrome`). Ruled 19 Nov: H1 to H10 and H12 built; H11 left for a later proposal.

## Fail / fix

| #   | Topic                       | Fail                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Fix                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| --- | --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| H1  | Keyboard into the card      | The card is portalled and nothing proxies Tab, so its pin and link buttons are out of keyboard reach (`HoverCard.tsx:150`). Ikuisuus has the same gap; it pins with Shift+Enter but focus never enters   | Tab from the trigger enters the open card through Zag's `proxyTabFocus` (as its popover does); Shift+Tab returns to the trigger; Tab past the last stop goes on after the trigger                    |
| H2  | Leaving the card            | Zag's hover-card prevents close on focus-out, so a card stays open after Tab leaves it                                                                                                                   | Focus leaving the card closes it unless pinned                                                                                                                                                       |
| H3  | Escape on a pinned card     | `hold` drops every close request (`floating.ts:75-78`), so Escape does nothing once pinned; the JSDoc says otherwise. Ikuisuus closes a pinned card on Escape                                            | Escape unpins and closes the innermost card; an outside click still leaves a pinned card alone                                                                                                       |
| H4  | Focus return                | Neither side returns focus: Ikuisuus unmounts and focus falls to `body`; Arkhé has no handling                                                                                                           | Closing by Escape or the close button returns focus to the trigger when focus was inside the card                                                                                                    |
| H5  | Roles and names             | No role or aria on card or trigger (Zag gives `tabIndex` and `hidden` only). Ikuisuus: card `role="region"` named by its title, trigger `aria-describedby` while open                                    | Card `role="dialog"`, non-modal, `aria-labelledby` its title. Link trigger: `aria-describedby` the card body (no `summary` prop needed). Button and inline trigger: `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` |
| H6  | Inline trigger              | `inline` renders `<span tabIndex=0>` with no role and no Enter or Space (`HintTrigger.tsx:206-211`). Ikuisuus is worse: a span trigger has no tab stop, so nested keywords without a link are mouse-only | Inline trigger gets `role="button"` and Enter or Space to toggle and pin                                                                                                                             |
| H7  | Click and Enter on a button | A desktop click or Enter on a button trigger does nothing; only the pin button pins                                                                                                                      | Click or Enter on a button or inline trigger pins and unpins                                                                                                                                         |
| H8  | Close button                | No close button. Ikuisuus has an always-visible close with a translatable label (`CardChrome.tsx:67-71`)                                                                                                 | Header close button from `labels.close`, shown while pinned                                                                                                                                          |
| H9  | Tall cards                  | Hover-card content has no height cap and a fixed `max-width: 22rem`. Ikuisuus caps at `80vh` with a scrolling body and picks 250 or 512 px wide by content length                                        | Content fits the viewport like Menu and Popover; width as a prop (`narrow` / `wide`) so Ikuisuus keeps its two widths                                                                                |
| H10 | Off switch                  | Neither side has a global one; Ikuisuus has per-card `noCard`                                                                                                                                            | `ArkheProvider` `hoverCards: false`, plus a per-card override                                                                                                                                        |
| H11 | Drag to detach              | Ikuisuus drags a card free, which pins it; Shift held while leaving also pins. Arkhé has neither                                                                                                         | Out of scope, or a later proposal: say which                                                                                                                                                         |
| H12 | Tests                       | Arkhé has no tests for Escape, focus-open, keyboard reach or aria; Ikuisuus none for touch, nesting or focus return                                                                                      | Unit in both ports plus e2e: Tab in and out, Shift+Tab back, Escape on pinned and nested cards, focus return, axe on an open card                                                                    |

## Already settled

- A desktop click on a link trigger follows the link, on both sides (answers the old Q1).
- Touch: Arkhé toggles per tap and closes on an outside tap; Ikuisuus always pins and never closes on a tap. Arkhé's is the better one (P48 says "as in Ikuisuus", which it improves on).
- Hover delays with a grace gap, focus opens without moving focus, the card stays while hovered (WCAG 1.4.13), Escape closes the innermost card, nesting keeps the parent open, reduced motion, React and Svelte DOM parity, the pin button's `aria-pressed`.

## Stays on the Ikuisuus side

Shard caching and prefetch inside its `load`, page-baked shards passed as `content`, lazy card and MDX chunks, `noLink` through `inline`, a 404 that shows Arkhé's error status or no card.
